SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: -Stress - Intonation, part of JOBS AND OCCUPATIONS Suggested Vocabulary: job, occupation, accountant, actor, d in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: which statements and questions are used, Learners with postural defects or short 1. Why should we pronounce sounds and words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sort statements and questions based on rising and falling intonation, • pronounce words and phrases with the target sounds /f/ and /v/, correctly,
